Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hy, some questions:

1. Call of the Hungry dead assign -1 intercept to ANY minion who tries to
block the action modified by CotHD,
or just to the minion blocking the action when CotHD is played?

2. Palatial estate gives the blood "at the beginning of the master phase";
is this wording accorded with the actual "untap phase" clarification:

At the start of the untap phase" is another way of specifying "during the
untap phase".
Neither phrasing specifies a period of time before the other. [RTR 19990105]

Or i can't choose to take a blood from a vamp with a blood doll *before*
that he/she gains a blood with a palatial estate?

3. A Brujah anti is blocked, he plays Blood Brother Ambush,
then another Brujah anti (with obf) plays mask of 1k faces and plays another
BBA.
What happens to the first BBA ?

Thanks in advance

AEmilianus

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <Lbsc7.2751$JY1.1...@news.infostrada.it>, Tetragrammaton
<nospam_a...@hotmail.com> writes

>1. Call of the Hungry dead assign -1 intercept to ANY minion who tries to
>block the action modified by CotHD,
>or just to the minion blocking the action when CotHD is played?

"The blocking minion gets -1 intercept."

i.e. the minion currently attempting a block.

>2. Palatial estate gives the blood "at the beginning of the master phase";
>is this wording accorded with the actual "untap phase" clarification:

Compare "master phase" vs "untap phase".

>At the start of the untap phase" is another way of specifying "during the
>untap phase".
>Neither phrasing specifies a period of time before the other. [RTR 19990105]

Not relevant, as it is a ruling on untap phase - which is entirely
different because of the "untap your minions" requirement.

>Or i can't choose to take a blood from a vamp with a blood doll *before*
>that he/she gains a blood with a palatial estate?

The blood is given at the beginning of the master phase.

Then you can use your Blood Doll.

>3. A Brujah anti is blocked, he plays Blood Brother Ambush,

And promptly enters combat as a result of BBA text.

>then another Brujah anti (with obf) plays mask of 1k faces

Who is ineligible to play it because of the ruling on Mask (not playable
during action resolution/combat).

> and plays another
>BBA.
>What happens to the first BBA ?

Moot.
